taxes.dated: Legimonaco, Code des taxes sur le chiffre d'affaires, version du 1er janvier 2025, via the Internet Archive 2025-05-13 (`mc/law/code_taxes_ca_v20250101_wb20250513.xml`)

medicines taken at 2,10 % (art. 59: reimbursable); non-reimbursable medicines are at 10 % (art. 53)

the franchise threshold is the goods one (85 000 euros, previous year); the 37 500 euros services threshold and the current-year limits are not applied
